content: AGP 9.2.0 (April 2026) is latest stable; requires Gradle >= 9.4.1, JDK >= 17, supports up to API 37. AGP 9.0 introduced built-in Kotlin enabled by default (embedded KGP 2.2.10 runtime dep); org.jetbrains.kotlin.android plugin incompatible with new DSL; android.builtInKotlin=false opt-out removed in AGP 10 (2026). KSP below 2.2.10-2.0.2 auto-upgraded.
